title: ATTP at the start of an ambitious project – ACT RISE
body_html:
The “Romania – Republic of Moldova ACT!” project is an outstanding initiative to promote sport for all, launched today, 25 March.

This novel project, approved by the European Commission under the Erasmus+ programme, aims to strengthen cooperation between sports organisations from Romania, the Republic of Moldova and other countries such as Armenia, Azerbaijan, Georgia and Ukraine, to implement initiatives that encourage active participation in sport, especially among young people and vulnerable groups.

The project is a unique development opportunity for the sports sector, promoting international cooperation, social inclusion and equal access to sporting activities, and includes several initiatives that aim to promote inclusive, accessible physical activity for everyone, including:

· Developing grassroots sport – creating and promoting sports programmes accessible to all social groups;

· Inclusion and diversity in sport – supporting the participation of people with disabilities, minorities and disadvantaged groups in sporting activities;

· Mobility for coaches and athletes – exchanges of experience and professional training for sports specialists;

· International sports events – competitions and activities that encourage cooperation between countries and promote an active lifestyle.

Within the project, ATTP has committed to several principles that are essential for the success and sustainability of ACT RISE, such as:

1. Promoting table tennis among young people from disadvantaged backgrounds and integrating people with disabilities into sporting activities.

2. Active involvement of the community, working with schools, local authorities, non-governmental organisations and other relevant institutions, which will bring valuable support and feedback.

3. Accessibility for everyone, regardless of age, gender, social status or physical ability. This should promote inclusion and encourage everyone to take an active part.

4. Sustainability by identifying funding sources and long-term partnerships.

5. Promoting education and positive values, so that sport becomes an excellent means of passing on important values such as teamwork, mutual respect, perseverance and discipline. Education through sport is an essential element of a successful social project.
